Global Clean Energy Investment Reaches New Record in 2026

GENEVA — Worldwide investment in renewable energy and clean grid infrastructure surpassed two trillion dollars this year, according to the annual Energy Transition Outlook report released Monday.

The surge was driven primarily by massive expansions in solar photovoltaic installations and grid-scale battery storage deployments across Europe, Asia, and North America. Plummeting manufacturing costs for next-generation sodium-ion and solid-state batteries have significantly lowered barriers to continuous renewable baseload integration.

"We are witnessing an unprecedented acceleration in grid modernization," said lead analyst Elena Rostova. "The economic fundamentals now firmly favor renewable deployment over fossil fuel capacity expansion across nearly all major markets."
